statement: PoseBench found that deep-learning cofolding methods generally outperform comparable docking baselines, but remain challenged by new protein–ligand binding poses, apo-to-holo settings, uncommon interaction targets and multiligand complexes; models also struggle to balance structural accuracy with chemical specificity.
locator: Abstract and Main; Nature Machine Intelligence article s42256-025-01160-1
notes: High-signal evidence against treating headline docking accuracy as robust real-world generalization.
